Name: Irrigation (TMX Buildables)
Author: proudunicorn
Description:
[size=5]Note: There are now 2 versions (A and B).[/size]

[list]
[*]Version A is for the farm
[*]Version B is for the secret location
[/list]The secret location is: [spoiler]
Ginger Island Farm
[/spoiler]
You can use [b]whichever [/b]version you like, and I have updated the manifests so you can use [b]both [/b]if you like!

***************************************************************************************************************

Want to customise the waterways on your farm? Want to add a small watering hole in an animal pen? This mod allows you to create a network of water channels on your farm throught the TMX buildables menu.

At the moment there are a couple of ready made configurations:

[img]https://i.ibb.co/g4Ms8Vz/irri2.png[/img] A horizontal channel

[img]https://i.ibb.co/BG1sv39/irri1.png[/img]﻿ A vertical channel

[img]https://i.ibb.co/tLv68pQ/irri3.png[/img] A tiny watering hole

[img]https://i.ibb.co/HChV3qW/irri4.png[/img] A slightly bigger watering hole

And a bunch of other sections you can use to build your own network, including lengths, ends corners, and intersections

e.g:

[img]https://i.ibb.co/D4vF2Fn/irri1d.png[/img] ﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/nC7PfwJ/irri1a.png[/img] ﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/ZGvDL3n/irri5e.png[/img] ﻿﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/9twFGdq/irri5a.png[/img]﻿

There are lots more, these are just examples.

You can make all sorts of configurations, and should work with all recolors:

[img]https://i.ibb.co/h29vBjv/Screenshot-100.png[/img]﻿

[size=6][size=5]To do:[/size]
[size=4]Next I am going to make ones with grass edging, as at the moment it only looks good on dirt.[/size]
[size=4]I also would like add some more tiles so you can make an actual pond, however this will be a very big job.[/size]
[/size]
